name: Macroeconomics
summary: Research addresses economic growth, crises, inflation, sovereign debt, productivity, trade, and the institutions that guide macroeconomic policy.
overview: The agenda includes the consequences of sovereign default, productivity costs during crises, trade agreements, monetary institutions, and inflation expectations in Mexico.

projects.title: Inflation Expectations and the Phillips Curve in Mexico
projects.summary: Studies the relationship between inflation expectations and price dynamics in Mexico, including the role of credibility in the inflation-targeting regime.
